learningObjectives: Use Python variables and basic data types.

activities.instruction: Click each part of the assignment to reveal its role.

descriptions: The variable name used to reference the stored value.
The assignment operator that binds the value to the variable.
The value assigned to the variable.
The data type of the assigned value.
